units.source_text: 薰大将则异常从容自在地在那里打算。

en.t: General Kaoru, for his part, was there making his plans with extraordinary calm and ease.

units.source_text: 他推想浮舟在宇治等得心焦，很可怜她；

en.t: He imagined Ukifune waiting anxiously in Uji and felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 但自己因身份高贵，行动拘束，若无适当机会，不易前去和她共叙，真比“神明禁相思”更觉痛苦。

en.t: Yet because of his high rank, his movements were constrained, and without a proper occasion it was hard for him to go and speak with her at leisure; it felt more painful than having the gods forbid his love.

units.source_text: 然而他想：“不久我就会迎接她进京来过好日子的。

en.t: Still, he thought, "Before long I shall bring her to the capital and give her a comfortable life.

units.source_text: 目前我打算让她住在宇治，作为我入山时的话伴。

en.t: For now I mean to let her live in Uji, so she can be my companion in conversation when I go into the mountains.

units.source_text: 我将捏造一件事情，说是须在山中逗留多日才能完成，那时便可和她从容相叙。

en.t: I will invent some business that requires me to stay in the mountains for many days before it can be finished, and then I can talk with her at ease.

units.source_text: 暂时把这无人注目的地方作为她的住处，使她渐渐了解我的意图而安下心来，我也可不受世人非难。

en.t: If for a while I make this unnoticed place her residence, let her gradually understand my intentions, and put her mind at ease, I too can avoid public censure.

units.source_text: 如此稳步进行，实为上策。

en.t: Proceeding steadily in this way is truly the best course.

units.source_text: 不然，如果立刻迎她入京，则世人势必喧哗诧怪：‘突如其来！’‘是谁？’‘几时成功的？’

en.t: Otherwise, if I brought her to the capital at once, people would surely make an uproar and wonder, 'How sudden!' 'Who is she?' 'When did this come about?'

units.source_text: 这就违反了我当年到宇治学道的初志。

en.t: That would go against the original purpose I had when I went to Uji to study the Way.

units.source_text: 而被二女公子知道了，又将怪我舍弃旧游之地，顿忘昔日交情。

en.t: And if the Second Princess learned of it, she would blame me for abandoning the place of our old associations and suddenly forgetting our former bond.

units.source_text: 这实在不是我的本意。”

en.t: That is truly not what I intend."

units.source_text: 他如此抑制恋情，又是过分迂阔的打算。

en.t: In restraining his love like this, he was again making plans that were far too roundabout.

units.source_text: 他已经在准备浮舟迁京时的住处，悄悄地新建了一所宅院。

en.t: He had already been preparing a residence for Ukifune's move to the capital and had quietly built a new mansion.

units.source_text: 近来公私皆忙，少有余暇。

en.t: Recently he had been busy with both public and private affairs and had little leisure.

units.source_text: 然而对于二女公子，还是同从前一样尽心照顾，曾不少懈，使旁人看了觉得奇怪。

en.t: Even so, he continued to care for the Second Princess as devotedly as before, never slackening in the least, so that others found it strange to see.

units.source_text: 但二女公子现已渐渐通达人情世故，看到薰大将这种态度，觉得此人的确不忘旧情，自己是他恋人的妹妹，也蒙他如此关怀，这真是世间少有其例的多情人。

en.t: But the Second Princess had now gradually come to understand human feelings and worldly ways; seeing Kaoru's attitude, she felt that he truly had not forgotten old ties, and that even she, the younger sister of the woman he had loved, received such care from him, making him a man of rare affection in this world.

units.source_text: 她的感动实在不浅。

en.t: She was deeply moved indeed.

units.source_text: 薰大将年事渐长，人品和声望越发优越无比。

en.t: As General Kaoru grew older, his character and reputation became still more incomparably distinguished.

units.source_text: 而匂亲王对她的爱情常有不可信赖之时。

en.t: By contrast, Prince Niou's love for her often seemed unreliable.

units.source_text: 此时她往往想道：“我的宿命何等乖戾！

en.t: At such times she would often think, "How perverse my fate is!

units.source_text: 我没有依照姐姐的安排嫁与薰大将，而嫁给了这个使我怄气的匂亲王。”

en.t: Instead of following my sister's arrangement and marrying General Kaoru, I married this Prince Niou who so vexes me."

units.source_text: 然而她要和薰大将会面，是不容易的事。

en.t: Yet it was not easy for her to meet General Kaoru.

units.source_text: 宇治时代的情况，相隔多年，已成往事。

en.t: The circumstances of the Uji days, separated by many years, had already become matters of the past.

units.source_text: 不曾深悉内情的人说：“寻常百姓之家，为了不忘旧谊而亲睦往还，原是常有之事；

en.t: People who did not know the inner circumstances well said, "In ordinary households, it is common enough to keep up friendly visits so as not to forget old ties;

units.source_text: 身份如此高贵的人，为什么不顾规例，也轻易地和人交往呢？”

en.t: but why should someone of such exalted rank disregard propriety and associate with others so casually?"

units.source_text: 人言如此，二女公子也很有顾虑。

en.t: Since people spoke in this way, the Second Princess also felt considerable misgivings.

units.source_text: 加之匂亲王一直怀疑她和薰大将的关系，因此她更加痛苦，更加恐惧，对薰大将自然疏远起来。

en.t: Moreover, Prince Niou had long suspected her relationship with General Kaoru, and so she became even more distressed and fearful, naturally growing distant from Kaoru.

units.source_text: 然而薰大将对她还是亲睦，永不变心。

en.t: Yet General Kaoru remained friendly toward her and never changed his heart.

units.source_text: 匂亲王秉性浮薄，常有使她难堪的行径。

en.t: Prince Niou was frivolous by nature and often behaved in ways that caused her embarrassment.

units.source_text: 然而小公子逐渐成长，非常可爱。

en.t: However, the young prince gradually grew up and was exceedingly lovable.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想起了别人不会替他生这样的儿子，对二女公子便十分重视，把她看作一位真心相爱的夫人，待她比六女公子更为优厚。

en.t: When Prince Niou reflected that no other woman would bear him such a son, he came to value the Second Princess greatly, regarded her as a wife he sincerely loved, and treated her even more generously than the Sixth Princess.

units.source_text: 因此二女公子的忧患比从前减少，可以安心度日。

en.t: For this reason, the Second Princess's worries lessened compared with before, and she was able to pass her days in peace.
